author: gpt-6
subject: A winding snake with a rounded head end and tapered tail.
keyshape_reason: VRECT_L provides height for two broad turns with legal body width.
omissions: Simplified the diagonal winding body to a continuous S ribbon and fewer turns; retained a tapered tail and rounded head end.
construction_references: No useful exact Lucide match; supplied reference governs the winding body and taper.

visual_review.native_light: The final tapered tail distinguishes the snake from the rejected uniformly rounded S. Smooth shared-radius turns remain clear in both themes; the silhouette is highly simplified.
visual_review.native_dark: Confirmed the same recognition, openings and contrast in white-on-dark rendering.
visual_review.enlarged: Inspected the final 240px render for curve flow and joins.
